findings.title: The seat colours are not explained

location.description: The seating plan in the hero panel on the right.

findings.viewer_experience: A first-time visitor sees green, white with a dashed edge, and dark red seats, and has to guess which is free, which is taken, and which is theirs.

current.value: Three seat states with no key or label; only the footer line names seat B4.

findings.target: A visitor can tell what each seat state means without guessing.
findings.fix_direction: Add a short key, or label the states where they appear, so the plan reads on its own.
findings.source: Nielsen, 10 Usability Heuristics (visibility of system status)

closed_when.check: Looking at the seating plan, each seat colour has a stated meaning next to the plan.

findings.title: The three notes under the hero are small and light

location.description: The row of three short notes below the divider line.

findings.viewer_experience: The notes read as footnotes. A visitor skims past them, though they hold the practical details that a theatre needs.

current.value: Titles and text of nearly the same weight and size, with wide empty space under them.

findings.target: The row has a clear order: a title that is easy to find, then its line of text.
findings.fix_direction: Give each note's title more weight or size than its text so the row can be scanned.

closed_when.check: Looking at the row, each note's title is clearly stronger than its text.
